name: Play and Exploration Grant Application
shortDescriptionEnglish: The Play and Exploration Grant is a one-time grant provided to regulated child care facilities as a component of Saskatchewan’s Action Plan for the Canada-Saskatchewan Canada-Wide Early Learning and Child Care Agreement.

agency.name: Education
agency.description: The mandate of the Ministry of Education is to advance the social, economic and personal well-being of Saskatchewan people through leadership and support programs from early childhood development, through pre-kindergarten to grade 12, to technical training and post-secondary education, and through public library services.
